data.comment:
# Comfy Vidu Q2- Reference to Video

Generate videos with reference-based consistency for up to 3 subjects, maintaining character and style continuity across the video sequence with cinematic camera movements. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_vidu_q2_r2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: @a(red-haired woman in elegant attire) sits on a fallen log in the muted green forest, her hands clasped gently. @b(aged robot with weathered white-grey body) stands before her, its arms still extended in an open gesture. The woman looks up at the robot's glowing orange eyes, a gentle smile forming. The robot speaks in a whisper-soft, almost human-like voice with minimal mechanical resonance—quiet and intimate, as if sharing a secret. The woman responds in a soft, contemplative tone. Camera circles around them in a slow arc, revealing the depth of the forest behind. Natural forest ambience at low volume: soft wind through leaves, occasional bird songs. The robot's internal mechanisms are nearly silent, only a faint, rhythmic hum.
